# User signed in (`logon`)

**Kind:** trigger · **Category:** Computer & sign-in · **Available in:** personal and machine automations

Fires when a user signs in to Windows. The user who signed in is available to conditions and to actions as {{ user }}.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `user` | user or list of users | no |  | Only fire when one of these users signs in. Accepts a user name (samet), DOMAIN\name, a SID, or wildcards (admin*). Leave empty for any user. |
| `session` | one of: `any`, `local`, `remote` | no | `any` | Which kind of sign-in: at the computer (local), over Remote Desktop (remote), or either (any). |

## Example

```yaml
triggers:
  - type: logon
    user: samet
    session: local
```

## Notes

In personal automations this fires when you sign in (the agent starts right after sign-in and receives the event from the service). Signing back in after locking the screen is an `unlock`, not a `logon`.
